I'm not really sure what this means as 'validity' is not a unitary concept. Best I can think of though is to run some simulations and see how well an AI can be trained relative to the simpler factor modeling structures. I suspect AI models will outperform at some point, but these may take extremely large datasets to do so due to the sheer number of parameters that are often required. HTH.

Phil
